props.gloss_en: the mishna: a woman may not go out with strings of wool
the mishna: nor with strings of flax
the mishna: and she may not immerse with them until she loosens them
Rabba bar Avuh: the immersion clause is saying 'what is the reason' [for the prohibition on going out]

why may a woman not go out with wool or flax strings? because the Sages said that on a weekday she may not immerse with them until she loosens them; so on Shabbat she may not go out with them, lest a mitzva immersion befall her and she untie them and come to carry them four cubits in the public domain
Rav Kahana to Rav: hollow chains (tichei chalilata) -- what [is the law]?
Rav: you are speaking of a woven thing?
anything woven, they did not decree [against]
Rav Huna b. R' Yehoshua: I saw that my sisters are not particular about them
what is between this version and that version? between them are dirty ones
on the version that said 'anything woven they did not decree', these [dirty ones] too are woven
on the version that you said is because of being particular -- since they are dirty, she is particular about them
the Mikvaot mishna: these interpose in a person -- strings of wool
...and strings of flax
...and the straps on girls' heads
R' Yehuda: [strings] of wool do not interpose
R' Yehuda: [strings] of hair do not interpose
R' Yehuda: because the water enters them
Rav Huna: and all of these we learned of [strings on] girls' heads
Rav Yosef: this is Rav Huna's reason -- because a woman does not strangle herself
the baraita: girls may go out with the strings in their ears
the baraita: but not with the chavakin at their necks
Ravina: here [the baraita] deals with a katla, with which a woman does strangle herself
Ravina: for it pleases her to look fleshy

objections.gloss_en: טבילה מאן דכר שמה? -- the mishna is about going out on Shabbat; who mentioned immersion?

answered_by.gloss_en: מה טעם קאמר: the immersion clause gives the reason she may not go out with them (= p_ma_taam_kaamar, p_shema_tishrem)

objections.gloss_en: מתקיף לה רב יוסף: למעוטי מאי? אילימא למעוטי דצואר -- ודמאי? אילימא דצמר: השתא רך על גבי קשה חוצץ, רך על גבי רך מיבעיא? ואלא דחוטי פשתן: השתא קשה על גבי קשה חוצץ, קשה על גבי רך מיבעיא? -- what would 'on girls' heads' exclude? the neck? but if wool or flax interposes on the (harder) hair, all the more on the (soft) neck

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אמר רב יוסף, היינו טעמא דרב הונא: לפי שאין אשה חונקת את עצמה (= p_ein_isha_chonekt)

objections.gloss_en: איתיביה אביי: הבנות יוצאות בחוטין שבאזניהן אבל לא בחבקין שבצואריהן; ואי אמרת אין אשה חונקת עצמה, חבקין שבצואריהן אמאי לא?

answered_by.gloss_en: הכא בקטלא עסקינן, דאשה חונקת את עצמה, דניחא לה שתראה כבעלת בשר (= p_ravina_katla, p_katla_nicha_lah)
